writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 11
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: Apache directory listing is enabled and `.htaccess` is publicly readable — fuzzing reveals the hidden directory structure and leaks the password filename.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 10
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: Authorization is stored in a client-side cookie as `level10_authorized=no` — changing it to `yes` grants instant access.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 9
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: No injection point in Level 9 itself — reuse Basic 8's SSI vulnerability with a traversal path pointing to Level 9's directory to expose the hidden password file.

writeups.title: HackThisSite - Basic Mission 8
writeups.author: Ducky
writeups.summary: The name field saves input into a `.shtml` file processed by the server — injecting an SSI `exec` directive lists the directory and reveals the hidden password file.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 7
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: The year input is passed directly to the UNIX `cal` command — injecting `;ls -la` reveals a hidden password file in the directory.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 6
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: The encryption shifts each character forward by its position index — reverse it by subtracting the position from each ASCII value.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 5
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: Despite claims of extra security, the hidden email input is still client-side — same Basic 4 method works unchanged.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 4
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: The recipient email is a hidden input — change it to your own address and Sam's password gets emailed directly to you.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 3
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: The password file path is hardcoded in a hidden HTML input — just open it directly in the browser to grab the password.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 2
writeups.author: Ducky
writeups.summary: Submit a blank password — the missing password file means there's nothing to compare against.

writeups.title: HackThisSite — Basic Mission 1
writeups.author: ducky
writeups.summary: View the page source — the password is hardcoded in the HTML.
